title: Tax IDs (Go kit)
summary: Indonesian tax identities: the 16-digit NPWP (old 15-digit ones normalized with a leading 0; one not starting with 0 checked as the NIK it is; the all-zero placeholder refused), the NIK (length, the 38 province codes, region, birth date), the 22-digit NITKU and the head office's default, passport and Coretax 'Other' document numbers, which IDs name a person, an unofficial NPWP check digit as a warning, and masking for display. Formats only — registration is DJP's to confirm.
when_to_use: A module stores or checks an NPWP, NIK, NITKU, or passport number — customers, suppliers, employees, the company profile.
when_not_to_use: Confirming that a number is registered or that a party is a PKP — only Coretax/DJP can.
Tax calculations (PPN, PPh) — a tax module's.
